project: NeuroVision AI – Autonomous MRI Clinical Decision Support System

subsystem_architecture.agent_1_medical_analysis: Responsible for 3D MRI feature extraction, tumor ROI segmentation, volumetric computation, Grad-CAM visual heatmaps, and multimodal vector embeddings.
subsystem_architecture.agent_2_clinical_decision: Responsible for integrating MRI findings with patient demographics, querying medical literature via RAG, multi-agent clinical reasoning (LangGraph), and generating evidence-supported clinical reports.

subject_id.description: Unique patient identifier in BraTS 2020 (e.g. BraTS20_Training_001)

patient_dir.description: Filesystem directory path containing the patient's MRI sequences

t1_path.description: Path to NIfTI T1-weighted native MRI (anatomical structure)

t1ce_path.description: Path to NIfTI T1ce MRI (Gadolinium contrast, vascular tumor core)

t2_path.description: Path to NIfTI T2-weighted MRI (fluid-sensitive, peritumoral edema)

flair_path.description: Path to NIfTI FLAIR MRI (CSF-attenuated edema delineation)

seg_path.description: Path to ground truth segmentation mask (labels: 0, 1, 2, 4)

is_complete.description: True if all 4 MRI sequences and segmentation mask exist and are valid

shape.description: 3D matrix dimensions (X, Y, Z voxels), standard: (240, 240, 155)

voxel_spacing_mm.description: Physical voxel resolution in mm, standard: (1.0, 1.0, 1.0) isotropic

orientation.description: Anatomical coordinate orientation (standard: LPS - Left, Posterior, Superior)

data_type.description: Header voxel intensity storage type (e.g., int16)

label.description: Binary integer target: 1 for HGG, 0 for LGG

age.description: Patient age at diagnosis in years (where documented)

survival_days.description: Overall survival duration in days from diagnosis

extent_of_resection.description: Surgical resection status (e.g., GTR = Gross Total Resection, STR = Subtotal Resection)

has_clinical_history.description: True if patient has documented clinical survival/demographic covariates

retrieval_eligible.description: True if patient has complete imaging and confirmed grade, qualifying for FAISS similarity indexing

tcia_id.description: Corresponding Subject ID in The Cancer Imaging Archive (TCIA/TCGA)

brats_2019_id.description: Subject identifier in BraTS 2019 challenge cohort

brats_2018_id.description: Subject identifier in BraTS 2018 challenge cohort

brats_2017_id.description: Subject identifier in BraTS 2017 challenge cohort
